title: Implement bounded pools and reservation ledgers
runtime_identity: Linux 6.18.44 x86_64, 2 vCPU, Node v22.22.2, Chromium 1194; loopback only
decision_or_code_delta: ram/ledger.js: Reservation ledger + slab pool: charge once, idle capacity visible, refusal allocates nothing, duplicate release counted.
expected: Every physical backing allocation is charged once, idle retained capacity is visible, and no unsuccessful admission silently allocates outside the cap.
memory_scope: gateway process (+ worker threads) and worker processes
residual_risks: self-reviewed by the implementer; no independent verification
rollback: delete ram/, gateway/worker-link.js, worker/core.js, worker/thread.js; restore the v1 files from hermit-vws 1.1.0-vws.1 (hashes in ledger/ramws_source.json)
linked_tests: admission is all-or-nothing across session/tenant/global and names the refusing scope
leases: capacity (not logical length) is charged; bucket, session caps; exhaustion and oversize are refused before allocation
randomized acquire/retain/release/close never breaks reconciliation and ends at zero
slab pool: actual capacity >= request, idle retention capped and visible, zero-fill on return, double/foreign return counted, oversize refused
